availabilityHelp.demonstration: Works end to end on synthetic data in our own environment. No customer has run it yet.
availabilityHelp.supervised_pilot: Running for at least one customer with every action reviewed by a person.
availabilityHelp.production_verified: Has completed at least one pilot with measured results and runs under defined management.

services.name: Referral response and follow-up
services.description: New referrals get a first response quickly, capacity is confirmed, intake starts the same day, and the referrer hears back when care starts.
services.targetCustomer: Small home care agencies (Medicaid waiver, private pay) that keep their current scheduler, EVV and billing systems.
requiredAccess: A referral inbox address we can receive from (forwarding or a dedicated alias)
Current capacity rules: counties, services, hours, weekly intake limit
Who at the agency approves replies
setupDeliverables: Referral inbox connected or a manual logging form in place
Capacity rules configured
Reply and follow-up templates approved by the agency
Baseline: median time to first response over the baseline period
ongoingDeliverables: Proposed first responses within the agreed window
7- and 30-day follow-up proposals to the referrer
Referral metrics on the morning report
customerResponsibilities: Approve or edit proposed replies inside the agreed window
Keep capacity rules current
Handle the clinical intake itself
deploiResponsibilities: Keep the inbox and rules running
volumeLimits: Up to 60 referrals per month per agency in the base management fee; more is quoted
exclusions: No marketing to new referral sources
humanReview: Every message a worker proposes waits for a named person at the agency or at Deploi to approve, edit or skip it. Auto-send is off unless the engagement turns it on for a specific worker.

successMeasures.label: Median time to first response
successMeasures.definition: Median of (first_response_at − received_at) over referrals received in the period. Denominator: referrals received.

successMeasures.label: Follow-up completion
successMeasures.definition: Referrals with a sent 7-day follow-up ÷ referrals that reached intake at least 7 days before period end.

services.name: Website Improvement
services.description: We improve your existing website so visitors can understand your services, contact your team, and take the next step more easily.
services.targetCustomer: Any small healthcare practice with an existing website on a common platform.
requiredAccess: Editor access to the existing website platform, arranged through an approved access method (never a password typed into a form)
Up to three pages to improve
An approval contact
setupDeliverables: Focused review of mobile usability, clarity and inquiry paths
Improvements to up to three existing pages
Clearer service descriptions and calls to action
Basic layout, readability and mobile-formatting fixes
One existing inquiry form improved, or one simple new form using an approved supported tool
Basic titles and meta descriptions for the selected pages
Contact-link, button and form-delivery checks
One consolidated revision round
Brief before-and-after summary
customerResponsibilities: Provide access and content
Approve the preview before anything is published
Keep hosting, domain and plugin subscriptions
deploiResponsibilities: Back up or document a rollback before changing anything
Stage or preview where the platform supports it
Verify publication and hand off a summary
volumeLimits: Five total staff hours including review, implementation, testing and revisions
One website, up to three pages, one revision round
exclusions: Complex scheduling, EHR, CRM or payment integrations
Hosting, domain, plugin or subscription charges
humanReview: Customer approval of the preview is required before publishing.

successMeasures.label: Published after approval
successMeasures.definition: Approved changes published and verified, with a handoff summary delivered.

services.name: Applicant follow-up and screening support

requiredAccess: Applicant export (CSV) or a job-board webhook
Interview slots
SMS consent language on the application
setupDeliverables: Applicant import or webhook connected
Screening questions and interview slots configured
Templates approved
ongoingDeliverables: Proposed first-contact texts and screening sequences
Applicant metrics on the morning report
customerResponsibilities: Collect SMS consent at application
Hold the interviews and make every hiring decision
Keep interview slots current
volumeLimits: Up to 80 applicants per month in the base fee
exclusions: No hiring decisions, background checks or offers

humanReview: Every message a worker proposes waits for a named person at the agency or at Deploi to approve, edit or skip it. Auto-send is off unless the engagement turns it on for a specific worker.

successMeasures.label: Interviews booked

successMeasures.label: Median time to first contact

services.name: EVV exception management

services.targetCustomer: Small home care agencies (Medicaid waiver, private pay) that keep their current scheduler, EVV and billing systems.
requiredAccess: EVV vendor visit export (CSV) on an agreed cadence
Authorization export
Program, payer and state for the correction rule set
setupDeliverables: CSV mapping configured for the vendor export
Correction rules configured with source and effective date
Billing-hold export tested
ongoingDeliverables: Exception list per import with deadline
Exception tile on the morning report

Make corrections in the EVV vendor system
Review the billing-hold list before billing
deploiResponsibilities: Run the rules and keep deadlines current with their sources
volumeLimits: Up to 3,000 visits per month in the base fee
